reviews.title: No one is answering emails
reviews.text: So all flights from 13th of Jan got cancelled due to legislation problems. Okay fine sh*t happens BUT THE WAY THEY HANDLED IT oh my god. Could've at least replied my (2) emails about rebooking my flight for an earlier date? No? okay.
reviews.author: Julia

reviews.title: Never ever in my life
reviews.text: I’ll never even recommend it. We are stacked at airport for a day and still haven’t left it. It’s super unreasonable. I had to be at a different country this morning. All flights are cancelled. This company are not even supposed to be named as company. Customer care a not responding after 10 calls. Can’t add any plus.
reviews.author: marta k

reviews.title: Good experience with customer service
reviews.text: Ernest had moved my flight to a time when I could not make it and they were most gracious after the fact with a full refund.
reviews.author: Katie O

reviews.title: Just in time
reviews.text: Nice stuff. Excellent service. Everything was strictly according to the schedule. Hope to fly this company once again
reviews.author: Alexander K

reviews.title: The worst experience ever!!!
reviews.text: I can’t believe how terrible this airline was, ruined my whole families trip to kiev. They changed my afternoon flight 3:40pm to morning 9:00am, with zero sympathy. I was forced to check in my carry on and pay additional 45€ At the airport. In addition if you have any size purse, even the size of the wallet, you will be charge an extra fee. The fact that Hahn Airlines represents them and I didn’t know whom I was flying with, is the biggest disappointment.
reviews.author: Valentina Martynovich

reviews.title: Shameful service
reviews.text: If u wanna not to get your flight , u have to get tickets via Ernest. I got tickets Kharkov - Rome 3 weeks before flight which was cancelled in 3 days after my reservation. I phoned to the company and got the new offer to change a flight for other day or airport. I changed my day but still got flight from Kharkov. They told me that flight will be for sure. But, suddenly, in 2 days i got new info my rebooked flight was cancelled, less than one week before flight. Such a nice surprise for Christmas. They offered a new flight from Kiev but if i wanted to take flight from Kiev i could make a reservation directly from Kiev. So, in the end, i took flight from Kiev but the airport service was terrible, flight was delayed without any info, cabin crew didnt care about people on boarding, even didn't say Hi. Thanks God , i came final destination. But , for sure, i will not recommend Ernest to my friends, relatives and other tourists. Never more Ernest.
reviews.author: OlgaBurm

reviews.title: Terrible Experience- Scam
reviews.text: I wish there was a way to give a negative 0 to this airline! My husband and I were scheduled to fly from Rome to Kharkiv and purchased our tickets months in advance. Ten days before the flight we received a notice that our flight has been cancelled. I have emailed the airlines 8 times and called them, but no answer. We have submitted a request for refund but no answer. Please stay away from booking Ernest. Terrible.... terrible
reviews.author: Alina

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Just horrible It was the first flight where nobody meets you at the entrance to greet you. Flight attendants were chatting, did not even look at people boarding. Leg room is smaller than Wizzair or Ryanair. But it is not the worst. I had a flight one MOnday 4 pm, arived to the airport 2 hours prior to see that my flight is not on the departure board. I asked the girl from touristic information what is going on, she told me the flight is cancelled. Should I mention that i as n4ever informed about that? Not via email or phone, nothing. The girl from topuristic information cazllled to the Ernest call center, asked hat is going on, gave them my booking number. They told three times that that flight is cancelled. I repetedly asked what I should do and how an I supposed to get home. They finally told that there is a flight next morning. Asked me if I want to take it. Promised to send me the confirmation to my email that I gave them over the phone, which they never did. So I was in the aorport, with no food, almost no money, waiting till the morning flight. In the worning flight got delayed for another hour and a half, and when we were in the plane they also told us they cannot depart because we have to wait for clearance. I was not offered any kind of compensation, and I did not even get any formal apology. No reason for flight canncellation/delay was given. I will not use these airlines again and I would not advice anybody to do so.
reviews.author: Ilona B

reviews.title: Ernest cancelled our flight from Odessa stranded us, and could not care less
reviews.text: Ernest cancelled our flight after we waited 12 hours in the airport. no reason or apology. That made us miss our connecting flights to Paris continuing to Miami. we had to purchase over 1K in tickets to make it home after having to stay one more day in Odessa, then in Warsaw for 2 additional days with hotel and meals. They only wish to refund our ticket price of $105 each. Stay away from this shady airline!!!! Fly anyone else. They don't care about customers.
reviews.author: SanMar Service

reviews.title: Love planning? Forget about that.
reviews.text: Just during one return trip: - Return flight time was changed to extremely early, so I had to re-book car at the airport (company which was initially chosen doesn't provide drop-key return). 3 weeks before the flight. So I paid penalty for the canceled car reservation at one company and had to look for another one. And you know, in summer time just in 3 weeks before flight - that's f..in hard and expensive - Outgoing flight was canceled just 2 days before the date. And I had it all already booked and paid - accommodation, car. So instead of having direct flight and a total trip of 6 hours I had to fly with changes and spend 12 hours for it. With a 2yo kid. Yeh, these guys definitely able to destroy your plans easily.
reviews.author: profigirator

reviews.title: The worst airline in the Europe
reviews.text: The fly was at 12:05 and they said that the fly will be at 13:30. After check in the graphic changed and the fly was delayed by 14:30. Once we arrived at the airport at 10:00 a.m we had to wait around 5 hours. Just terrible, better pay few euro more and get a better airline. Never fly with Ernest and BluePanorama. At least they can notice before via email or phone call and delay the check in also, no need check in close at 11;00 an for a aircraft that fly at 14;30
reviews.author: My Hostel in Berat

reviews.title: Worst Experience Ever at the Airport, Europe We Deserve 😖😢
reviews.text: Stay away from this air career. They have stupidly absurd regulations for hand luggage which applies unjustly to passengers. Some were not allowed to take carry-on bag + personal item (i.e. ladies bag, or laptop). Some passengers were lucky to take two pieces inside the cabin whereas others were forced to rearrange their belongings to make one piece. If they failed to do so they were forced to pay for extra weight, or buy expensive bags at the airport. The last was my case. I spent over €100 for the bag I don’t actually need just to board the plane. I do understand that rules exist to be followed but our flight was not full and some rows were totally free so some extra weight inside the cabin wouldn’t hurt the flight. But staff probably wanted to rip passengers off to make them pay more for extra pieces. Save your money and nerves and travel with other companies if possible.
reviews.author: Marina A

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text: It was the most awfull experience.... it was the first time with this company flying from Tirana to Milan.The flight was delayed by non less then 6 hours.... And the most terrible thing happened in the returning. Doing the check in online and passing all the other procedures and then surprisingly finding out that i could not get on the plane bc my ticket was cancelled!!!Having no explanation at all by the "custumer service" wich at the moment that didnt have an answer closed the phone in my face....So i had to stay at a hotel and pay also for another ticked in return the day after (offcourse with another company) ..still waiting for a refund and nothing...NEVER CHOOSE THIS COMPANY ITS A SCAM!!!!
reviews.author: margalina s

reviews.title: Never get this airline's!!!
reviews.text: Our departure should be on 7 November 2019 at 19.10 from Kiev to Bergamo. First company rescheduled our flight in hour, than in 2, in 3 and so on. In 00.00 flight was cancelled and rescheduled to the next day at 12.00, so passengers went home or to the hotels. About real problem company didn't tell us - real problem was in Ernest airlines didn't pay money to airport in time, so airport forbidden to land/depart planes this airline's. For the next day we went to the airport and there was the same story, airline's rescheduled every hour flight, support did not work, anyone couldn't told us about real problem. Local manager of that airline's said that the flight will be on any case, but 3 a.m. next day.So went home again. At 00.00 I made a call to this manager, he told me that flight will be in time, in third time we arrived to the airport and for this time flight was finally cancelled. CONCLUSION: We came 3 times to the airport, spent 3 days from vacation, spent a lot of money on accommodations in Milan, Como, Verona that were not refundable. I'll not take tickets this airline's ever.
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.title: THEIR CHECK-IN ONLINE AND THEIR COSTUMER SERVICE SUCK
reviews.text: The Check-In was 24h before the flight. Their server has problems. I wrote an email, I never got a reply back. I call them, I waited a lot of time to have someone to talk with, after 3 hours I got someone to talk with, she didn't give me a name or an operator number, she wasn't kind. At the end I have to do the check-in in the airport, so I gonna waste a lot of time for their server problem.
reviews.author: Davide G

reviews.title: Terrible service and language!
reviews.text: Shameful client relation. I had paid for a baggage until 10 kg. I had also my laptop bag with me. They wanted to charge 70 Euro for it. Such a shameful thing has never happened before, in 11 years with many many fly companies!
reviews.author: Olgi K

reviews.title: You may never get your refund
reviews.text: My experience with Ernest Airlines has been very disappointing, up to the point that I am starting to think that the company is cheating passengers with refunds. It is since July, as I've been trying to get a refund for my flight Kharkiv-Milan, which I could not take as it was rescheduled for 7 hours later from the initial departure time. Ernest Airlines / flyernest.ukraine has been ignoring my refund request and ALL my emails ever since.
reviews.author: Liudmyla Goncharenko

reviews.title: Luggage not included
reviews.text: support badly accesable, informations on brokers not displayed. This is very unprofessional, I can not recommend this experience.
reviews.author: Mio M

reviews.title: Bad Service
reviews.text: It’s our first time to ever encounter that you’re allowed only one bag for cabin. They will ask you to put your small personal bag inside the luggage which is ridiculous. There’s always a space under the seat to put your personal bag. It caused too much delay because of this drama. It’s not even a big bag. The Drama continues before entering the gate til inside the airplane.
reviews.author: Kaethe k

reviews.title: Very nice trip by Ernest Airways. Nice service, very plesant crew.
reviews.text: Nice flight with Ernest Airways. The crew was rather welcoming. Nice service. The trip was not so long. But I had a very good opportunity to make photos from the flying airplane as I was sitting near the window. Very nice view from the plane.
reviews.author: Gennadiy Kalashnikov

reviews.title: they cheat you with the size of hand luggage, to take away more money.
reviews.text: they cheat you with the size of hand luggage, to take away more money.Very bad experience..Continuous delays
reviews.author: Helgi L

reviews.title: Thanks for daring to enter our market
reviews.text: I am so much grateful that Ernest airlines exist in Ukraine. I am now applying to the Bologna university and need to fly back and forth quite often (I go via Milan some of the times). If there was no Ernest, I would probably have to sell my kidney to fly with our three-letter oligarch-owned monopoly. The time slots are also very good, no need to wake up at 4 am and feel like dying a day after. Two times I bought the ticket "today for tomorrow" for about 95 euros. This is very reasonable and gives flexibility to fly home when i'm done with something important, not when the date comes for which I bought ticket a month ago. + reasonable prices even at short notice + the cheapest checked-in luggage (15 kg) was 15 euros, which is a VERY good price, gives you freedom to not worry with juggling shampoo bottles or taking home an extra bottle of wine + the team is always super friendly, top friendly I would say + the planes are clean and with a lot of space for legs - as I understand the company doesn't own many planes, as, say, Lufthansa, and therefore it can be relatively more difficult for them to handle delays - one of the three flights I took was delayed 1.5 hours. However, only 3 out of 10 passport control counters were opened in Malpensa, and with the huge queue some English and Macedonians were missing their flights, while we were eventually at the gate just on time. Italian Bingo :) - I think it is a bad idea to plan tight connecting flights with Ernest Overall, I wish this company prosperity as I can imagine what it is like to do business in Ukraine. While I love my country a lot, in this respect we are jungle, really.
reviews.author: Valeria

reviews.title: Horrid
reviews.text: Literally could not have a worse experience. If I could give stars in the negatives I would. Plane was delayed for hours which eventually resulted in is landing at 2am with no more trains even running into the city centre. Alternatively a taxi is 150 euros. They loaded us into a shuttle to the actual plane from the gate but when the bus arrived the plane was not ready for us so we sat there on the bus for another 30 mins in the freezing cold. Finally, when we got onto the plane I think there was something wrong with the pressure. I’ve never experienced feeling so much pressure in my ears or nasal cavities on a plane before in my life. Also they still wanted to charge us for water.
reviews.author: Audrey

reviews.title: Not good airlines
reviews.text: Delay 3+ hours, bad service in Kyiv airport (Master Avia stuff), etc. I cannot recommend this airline!
reviews.author: Vlad

reviews.title: I'm not sure it is possible to get worse
reviews.text: Nearly 6 hours late. No apology. Ticket said carry on bag (upto 10kg) and other cabin bag. When I got to the front, was asked to put my cabin bag inside my other bag!! But then had to take it out because it didn't fit on the rack!!! And then watched a fight with another lady who could not put the too bags together. But why should she, the policy never said that!!! Uncomfortable seats when eventually on board. Just hopeless. They get 1 out of 5 because they got me from start to finish. Of course I did miss all connecting flights!! Not their problem apparently!
reviews.author: revmarkgriff

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Terrible service. It's always on delay. The staff is ok but the people who manage aren't good enough.
reviews.author: Fiona D

reviews.title: LUCKY OF BEING ALIVE
reviews.text: On Aug 2, 2019, we were going to fly with Ernest Airline from Venice (Italy) to Lviv (Ukraine). The departure time was delayed by 6 hours, and we took off at the mid of night on Aug 3. When the airplane was speeding up on runway, at the very end of the runway, one of two airplane engines blew up with loud bang, and thick smoke filled in all over passenger cabin. The pilot aborted taking off abruptly and the plane was almost falling apart. When the plane eventually stopped to rest, we couldn’t breathe because of smoke. We were scared and prayed. After holding us inside for 45 minutes, they delivered us to inside the airport building. It was complete disorder; nobody would explain what the passenger should do and where to go. It was early morning time. Then, we were taken to a hotel. But our baggage was left in the airport and we had hard time to recover it later. The suitcases were completely wet outside and inside because they left the baggage under open sky and it was raining. So, most of our close in the baggage was damaged. Staying in the hotel, nobody from the Airline contacted us, nobody offered any substituting flight. And we had to arrange ourselves to buy new tickets for a soonest flight which was available only in 3 days and was very expensive. We have applied for refund – compensation. It has been 6 weeks since our accident, the Ernest company does not respond on our claim. It is hard to reach them, because we are in the US, American citizens, and the Ernest Company is in Milan (Italy). The only good thing was that we were lucky staying alive. It could be much worse...
reviews.author: Georgiy

reviews.title: TERRIBLE
reviews.text: Only one word comes to my mind: TERRIBLE First flight with them September 2018 and certainly my last one. The first information was that the flight would be delayed around 1h to 1h30 (reason?). As the time came closer and closer, another delay of a couple of hours and again no information to the passengers about what was going on. After another couple of delays, the flight (supposed to leave in the morning) left at about 20:00 in an almost 10 HOUR DELAY. Customer voucher for snacks were provided, but that's about it. No information, no respect whatsoever. Cherry on top of the cake: - I have been contacting the airline since the end of last year for a refund, as it is due according to european regulation. - After an initial contact, a prompt response came from the airline: they admitted liability and offered a compensation in the form of a voucher for further travelling with Ernest (in which I would have to sign a form and therefore forfeit the right of a money refund - I refused and requested a money refund, as it is my right and since I had no interest in flying again with Ernest Airlines. - From then up until now, and despite my other 5-6 attemps to further contact, no response from anyone from customer service came. I have been flying for years with more than 15 different airlines, either full-service or low-cost. Never had a similar problem in : delays may happen, things can go off schedule, but the terrile customer service and plain CHEATING simply is not acceptable.
reviews.author: Vasco

reviews.title: Smooth flight.
reviews.text: Booked a holiday with Tui and discovered our flight Departure was with Ernest airways, never heard of them but was reassured by the holiday assistant they were ok. Checked their website found some poor reviews, so was a bit concerned. Holiday arrived went to Newcastle airport stood in the (all Tui flight) check in only when when nearing the front, only to find we were in the wrong check in line and Ernest had their own check in line I blame Tui for this as quite a few passengers did the same thing, thought hear we go good start. BUT when checking in we we’re confronted with a friendly check in assistant, this was the start we wanted. Flight time we were told was on time. Flight called to our gate number and boarded the aircraft welcomed by flight attendants, found seats easily. Seats in black leather and very clean. On departure the air flight attendant spoke about the safety in broken English which was hard to understand, this being the only downside to this flight. Only one drinks service and no duty frees. We arrived early in Verona the flight landed very smoothly, the whole flight was good, so don’t be alarmed if you are on a Ernest flight. I would fly with them again.
reviews.author: David r

reviews.title: Good budget Italian airline. Be aware of strict hand luggage rules
reviews.text: I bought a ticket yesterday. No price increase. No issues with payment and online check in. I purchased 15 kg luggage for 15 EUR online. I am in their Airbus A320 aircraft now. At baggage drop place they check hand luggage quantity and weight. Be aware, that they don't allow any extra hand items like a laptop bag. I usually fly with not budget airlines with a hand luggage as a trolley case and a laptop bag as a backpack with no issues. I flew with budget Ukrainian airline SkyUp with the extra backpack also. Most of budget airlines have strict rules like here. So just prepare only 1 hand luggage peace before your travel. Check in luggage is cheap to book online. I am in the airplane now. No issues at all here. I saw some RyanAir signs in a plane kitchen. Expected flight delay is 30 minutes. I rate 4 instead of 5 only because of the strict rule with an extra item on board. Good luck to the airline and its passengers!
reviews.author: Evgeniy64

reviews.title: Very pleased.
reviews.text: Having read reviews on Trip Advisor, we were extremely worried about having to fly with Ernest as a result of TUI having grounded their 737 Max planes. The actual flight was really good; plane left a little late but caught up to arrive in Verona on time. The plane was very clean, seats were extremely comfortable and the crew were really pleasant. We struggled to find out where the checking in desk was at Manchester and were given conflicting information by staff at the airport.
reviews.author: JGandIG

reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN!
reviews.text: Awful! The flight was scheduled to depart at 7.30pm. It is boarding now at 5am. The delay was not weather related but “operational circumstances”. That’s a night and most of a day lost now. What a joke. Never again.
reviews.author: Paul F

reviews.title: Spot on
reviews.text: The flights were spot ontime going and coming home,The plane was spotless and the crew were very friendly all in all a good experience.
reviews.author: Denis C

reviews.title: Flight as part of Inghams holiday
reviews.text: The flight out to Italy was faultless and was like clockwork-fabulous. Couldn’t say the same for return journey. An early start from our hotel, arriving in to the airport at 9.40 for 12noon flight to discover it was delayed until 14.40. They soon allowed us to book in and gave us vouchers for a sandwich and bottle of water each, so they knew we were being delayed then. Next thing we realised the flight was delayed again to 15.15 (no announcements or apologies or explanations) and finally delayed to 15.50 and they couldn’t decide which gate we were leaving from, moving us at least 4 times! We were all frazzled in the end spending 6 hours in the airport and we finally got home in Newcastle at 18.50. Not a nice experience.
reviews.author: Polly S

reviews.title: Surprisingly good
reviews.text: I hadn't heard of this airline until I discovered that I was booked on a return flight from Verona on Ernest rather than Thomson. The flight was excellent in every way. The plane was spacious, the cabin crew attentive, and the pilot communicated progress well. Unlike BA, cash can be used to purchase in-flight refreshments (Euros rather than Sterling). So, if you find that your carrier has changed unexpectedly, don't worry - based on this experience, Ernest are professional and reliable.
reviews.author: Eleanor719

reviews.title: Fair price, flexibility needed
reviews.text: We flew round-trip to Verona in mid July (2019) from Tirana/Rinas/Mother Teresa Airport on Ernest Airlines. (We bought our tickets several months earlier, in January.) About a week prior to our scheduled departure we received notice that our departure was postponed about 5 hours. (With delays, we would leave even later due to the plane arriving late to Albania.) Instead of arriving around 5PM in Verona, we reached our hotel well after midnight. In the same notice of our changed departure time, we were told that our return trip was cancelled altogether. We had to call customer service twice over the next few days to confirm that we were indeed rebooked on the next return flight (28 hours after our original return flight) because their website was extremely slow to reflect the changed itinerary. It would have saved us much anxiety if the airline would have just automatically re-booked us on the next flight to Albania rather than cause us to spend a number of hours researching alternate ways of getting back to Albania. The notice of cancellation was extremely unclear as to our options. Aside from the fact that the additional 24 hours away increased the cost of our trip in terms of meals, local transit, and lodging, we also had responsibilities at home that required we pay someone additional money to cover those needs. The additional day in Verona felt like a bit of a waste as we lost time moving out of one hotel to move to another (we were unable to extend our lodging reservation because it was full by the time we were notified of the return trip cancellation). All in all, the airfare may be a bit cheaper, but in our experience, it turned out to be more expensive than if we had simply taken flights on a more prominent airline. Lesson learned. We applied for compensation per EU standards for delayed flights and have yet to receive any reply. P.S. Our sincere apologies to everyone inconvenienced/impacted by the change in our travel plans.
reviews.author: NCER1999

reviews.title: Great airline, couldn’t fault it
reviews.text: My husband is so fussy and I was dreading travelling with this budget airline. He couldn’t find anything wrong with it! It was efficiently run, set off on time, arrived ahead of schedule, staff were great, refreshments were reasonably priced and as expected for a budget airline. It put me in mind of Monarch Airline which sadly went out of business. I wouldn’t hesitate to travel with this company in the future - and neither would hubby.
reviews.author: Denise M

reviews.title: Dishonest Company
reviews.text: My flight was cancelled one day before the flight. We were notified via voicemail, but as I was a US citizen abroad, I had no cell service. An email would have been very helpful, but I did not receive this. As such, we arrived at the airport ready to go, only to learn our flight was cancelled. They had no alternative flights for 2 days, so we had to book with AliItalia. I since completed my flight compensation rights per EU law 261-2004 and submitted it to Ernest customer care. After 7 weeks they have yet to reply, even though the law states they must reply within 6 weeks maximum. I have no escalated this to the Comissioner. It is ridiculous that I have to try this hard to get what is rightfully mine. What a dishonest and terrible company.
reviews.author: Michelle W

reviews.title: How travellers should be treated!
reviews.text: I had never heard of this company prior to booking a holiday with Tui! My loss! What a fantastic experience.From ease of checking in, complimentary 3 seats together-a saving of approx. £57, to arriving ahead of schedule despite a delayed take off. Cabin crew were a delight.Friendly,personable and smiley. The return journey was equally as good. For a budget airline the whole experience was 5 star and a good excuse for visiting Italy again. C
reviews.author: peterandteresaro2017

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: We were told Ernest airways was the main choice for returning to UK from the Italian Lakes. Maybe because a young child sitting behind me kicked the seat for the whole journey, accompanied by unconcerned grandparents or because staff were okay but no more than that, I cannot give the airline a glowing review. If you track flight times, it appears they often take longer than scheduled. Ours certainly did: 40 mins longer on a 2 hour timetable.
reviews.author: HeatherSt091

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: We traveled from Tirana to Bologna on August, the 28th. The flight was scheduled at 7:05 a.m. At the moment of our arrival at the airport (5 a.m) there was already the communication of a delay, with expected leave time 8:20. We did the check-in and then we asked for information about the delay at the company desk. The employee was not polite at all and said that there was a generic technical issue wih the palne during the previous rotation. He also said that the plane was now in Tirana and was due to go to Rome and come back before we can leave. It was 5:20 a.m. and thus we argued that there is no way we can depart at 8.20 (as they were still showing on monitors), the employee annswer unpolitely that "Rome is close". We waited nearby and after some time we observed that a crowd grouped at Ernest's info desk complaining, and we heared that there was an overbooking of roughly 10 tickets on our filght! A 1 or 2 tickets overbooking could happen but 10... seems incredible!! However we passed through security and passport checks and we waited at the gate from 7:45 a.m. At 8:00 they increased the expected delay and the monitors were updated to 9:45 expected departure time. With that amount of delay the company was due to offer us some snacks, as they actually did, but with a limitation to only water and coffe (no food at all). We finally boarded and the plane left Tirana at 10:30. I strongly suggest to avoid traveling with them.
reviews.author: Marco B

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: The most scandalous flight company I have ever taken. Only a hand luggage is allowed, thats ok, but in the hand luggage is considered and a very small arm bag. They forced me to put my arm bag in my luggage and I was obligated to move around the airport with documents and wallets in my hands. The bag that is considered the second luggage is the one in the picture. I will never choose it again and I definitly do not recommend this flight company to others.
reviews.author: Vilma S

reviews.title: Everything was nice
reviews.text: All went well. As for this cheap price, the flight and service was excellent. Even 1 hour delay was ok since this type of airlines have usually longer delays.
reviews.author: Muron T

reviews.title: Can't fault them
reviews.text: Having read some of the reviews before our flights, we were naturally concerned, so I am writing this for people in the same situation. Our experience with this airline was excellent. Both flights arrived at destination early. The seating was comfortable, the staff were pleasant and professional, and the service was great. The food quality was better than most I've experienced on budget airlines. We had two enjoyable flights that were conducted very safely and professionally. If anything, I would say our experience was better than with most other budget airlines. For anyone worried about safety standards, remember that all airlines flying into UK airspace have to meet the same standards of health and safety compliance. Remember also that all airlines experience problems with delays and maintenance. Frequently these are the result of making sure a safe flight can be conducted, and are in the passenger's own interest, so we shouldn't moan about them. I hadn't heard of Ernest Airlines before our recent trip, but I do think some of the reviews on this site are overly harsh, bordering on unfair, and where valid, would apply to most budget airlines (and many non-budget airlines!) Based on our (admittedly limited) experience with Ernest, you should have no concerns at all about flying with them.
reviews.author: ItalianLakesRus

reviews.title: Avoid flying this airline !!!
reviews.text: i got my trip canceled just one day before the flight and they told me that there was a problem with plane engines, and i was told to fly from another city , meanwhile the flight took of in the next day just like nothing had happened and when i call them ..they told me there was a fix ..but the plane was fully overbooked actually
reviews.author: Enis S

reviews.title: Extremely slow service on board
reviews.text: Booked a tui holiday and we're booked onto Ernest flight. Found seats very uncomfortable due to very straight back. Staff were horrendously slow on their trolley service, to the point that we were lucky to get anything before we landed and we were only in row 12. Unable to access toilet during this very long trolley service. Once trolley was back to front of plane, was told by head steward to use one at rear of plane where trolley was still blocking aisle. There was only 3 people in the queue at this time. Senior male steward was spending a lot of his time flirting with young stewardess. Would certainly not be keen to use this company again.
reviews.author: Jemima Jones

reviews.title: Awful Service
reviews.text: Booked this flight through Kiwi.com. They cancelled the flight without giving a reason and apparently they don't do refunds. Filled in the refund form but they just haven't replied. These people need looked into. How do they get away with it?This is nothing short of blatant robbery. I'm not after compensation, just a refund. .
reviews.author: Gazza

reviews.title: Nowhere near as bad as expected
reviews.text: Tui sub-contracted our holiday flights to Ernest, and having read previous reviews I was apprehensive to say the least. I was however pleasantly surprised. Although the plane was a little dated, seats were comfortable with adequate legroom, and the staff on board welcomed us in both Italian and English. They were professional and courteous throughout the flights. The flight times had been changed, but four months before we flew, so it really wasn’t an issue.
reviews.author: Helen H

reviews.title: Best flight experience in a long time
reviews.text: Was very concerned after reading the reviews here on Tripadvisor but I would recommend Ernest to anyone. Punctual and professional, very pleasant staff and possibly the best flight experience I’ve had for many years. Well done!
reviews.author: Alan W

reviews.title: Flight canceled and no refund issued
reviews.text: I paid €82 for a ticket from Tirana to Venice on flight EG214 for July 5, 2019, and the airline canceled the flight without explanation 10 days prior, leaving me scrambling to find a last minute way back to Italy. The email I received just said the flight was canceled, and did not mention anything about a refund, so after searching their webpage I found an online form to submit to request a refund. I completed the form over one month ago, and have still not received a refund nor heard any word at all from the airline. I tried to call the customer service phone line several times, but was never able to connect and speak to an actual person. I fly frequently all over Europe and this has easily been the most dissatisfying moment with any low-cost European airline. I would not recommend this airline to anyone. You’re better off paying extra for Ryanair, Easy Jet, or even Alitalia (believe it or not).
